title: Unit Event — The Power of Regret — Episode5 Dropouts

meta.Event Outline: Nene and her friends have made it to their final training destination, the Morinomiya Revue. While Nene goes into the experience excited to further grow as an actress, the boys' separate training and Emu's focus on business studies leave her attending practices on her own...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, beginning today, we will be holding auditions for “Luca”.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Starting with the protagonist. We ask all those interested in playing Luca to please step forward.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
This is it, Kusanagi.
Let's both do our best.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Seven, eight... Nine people.
I guess that's only natural.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (My portrayal of Luca has to be better than all of theirs, or I'll lose my chance...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I have to perform like my life depends on it...!)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: We'll start from the top, to the parting in the rose garden. Rehearsal format.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: So, the Luca in this scene will be played by Ms. Byakkomachi. And you'll be playing Princess Louise, Ms. Komiyama.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: That's enough, Ms. Taguchi. Next person.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Did you not hear me?
You're done. Next person!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(We've already gone through three Louises...
And it hasn't even been ten minutes since we began.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I thought they all did really well, but they've all been getting pulled. This is rough.)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
“Oh...
I-I'm sorry! Where are my manners? M-My name is Luca!”

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
“Luca Roussel...
I... I would feel so honored if you remembered...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is the moment when the young and timid Luca falls in love with Louise.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Luca wants to absorb all of Louise's beauty, but he has trouble looking directly at her. At the same time, he's worried that she's going to see him as behaving oddly.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Byakkomachi's providing such a natural depiction of his nervousness and anxiety.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (She's capturing Luca's pure spirit really well.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Okay, that should be enough.
Let's move to the next scene.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: The next Luca will be... Ms. Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(The next scene starts with a song...!
I have to do everything I can to match up against her acting!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I managed to get through the singing scene... But they pulled me not even a minute afterward...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And once more after that when I hesitated... At this rate, I...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: To cap the day, we'll be announcing today's cuts.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: At the end of each day, those who have been judged to lack what it takes will be barred from auditioning further.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (What do I do if they cut me on the first day...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I thought I did everything that I could just now...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
For the role of Luca, Ms. Sawada.
For the role of Louise, Ms. Nomura.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
For the role of Chancellor Bernal, Ms. Kumaki.
That is all.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Yeah, I can't blame her...
It must be frustrating...)

rows.Speaker: Luca Candidate A
rows.Line:
“Ah, Louise!
For you, I am willing to do anything. My life is yours!”

rows.Speaker: Luca Candidate B
rows.Line: “We must not leave a single rebel standing...!”

rows.Speaker: Luca Candidate C
rows.Line:
“Louise...
I just... Wanted to be by your side...”

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Do you honestly believe an audience is going to be moved by that kind of performance? Next!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Ms. Imura...
Did you actually practice for this?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Then, tell me more about this line.
What is Luca feeling at this very moment?

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line:
Th-This line...?
H-He's trying to profess his love for...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
We cannot allow someone with such a shallow understanding of her character to play the lead.
You are excused.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yeah, she wasn't able to answer that teacher's question... But I thought she did a really good job of capturing Luca's delicate personality...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Too slow.
Do you plan on dragging your feet like this during the real thing?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is an audition, so I was prepared for some degree of tension. But...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But I have to stay focused...
We've finished cleaning the rehearsal room, so I just have to go over what I was told today, and...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? There's a notebook on the ground.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
We cannot allow someone with such a shallow understanding of her character to play the lead.
You are excused.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I remember someone saying that she lives in this dorm...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's see... I have to take the south corridor to get to her dorm, so...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, Imura, thank goodness...
You came back.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, do you mean this one?
I was on my way to deliver it to you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Umm... If you have time, would you like to go to the school store together? It's hard not to feel hungry after a tough practice...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(She looks really sad...
Her eyes are all red...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I actually really liked your portrayal of Luca...

rows.Speaker: Imura
rows.Line: I don't want to hear any empty words! Not from someone who didn't get cut today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What...? Pity...?
I was just trying to...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's true, I did feel like I needed to say something...)
